text: Binary per-row flag: 1 if at least one other-user comment (parsed from the JSON list OC_comments, not by the OP) explicitly engages a specific example or premise actually stated in the OP's title or argument, by naming, quoting, or paraphrasing it and then addressing, rebutting, or building on it; agreement or disagreement both count, endorsement is not required. Generic replies addressing only the overall topic or conclusion without referring to a specific OP example/premise don't count. OP text is used only to identify targets. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting the outcome, even if in the argument. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement. Current text including marked edits is used, and no chronology is inferred from list order. Output 0 if OC_comments is a valid empty list, and null if OC_comments or the OP text (title, argument) is missing or malformed. Output is one scalar 0/1.
